R1_3.evidence: Supplement has no deposit-level metadata standard (no DataCite/Dublin Core record, no domain schema). ADS deposit earns R1.3 by construction (Row 4), but conjunctive scoring fails on the principal supplement. Methodological standards (OxCal, IntCal20) do not qualify.
